title: Jack Daniels and Uncle Nearest Distillery Bus Tour from Nashville
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
You will be required to ascend and descend many steps. This tour is not recommended for those with mobility challenges.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the rich history of Tennessee whiskey with an immersive tour of both Jack Daniel's and Uncle Nearest Distilleries. This 9.5-hour experience includes guided tours and tastings at both iconic locations, along with free time for lunch and sightseeing in downtown Lynchburg. Discover the intertwined stories of Jack Daniel and Nathan 'Nearest' Green, while enjoying seamless transportation from Nashville. Perfect for whiskey enthusiasts and history buffs alike, this tour offers a unique blend of education and enjoyment.

- Guided tours and tastings at Jack Daniel's and Uncle Nearest distilleries
- Transportation provided from downtown Nashville, ensuring convenience
- Free time to explore downtown Lynchburg and enjoy a lunch of your choice
- Must be 21 years or older; valid ID required for tastings
